name: Saudi Arabia
description: Saudi Arabia from the incense roads and the birth of Islam to the Saudi states, the founding of the kingdom, oil and Vision 2030.

checkpoints.name: Arabia of old
checkpoints.note: Incense caravans crossed the peninsula, and the Nabataeans carved their tombs at Hegra. Mecca was a trading town and a shrine of many gods.

checkpoints.name: The rise of Islam
checkpoints.note: Muhammad began preaching in Mecca around 610 and moved to Medina in 622. Islam spread far beyond Arabia, and the holy cities drew pilgrims from the whole Muslim world.

checkpoints.name: The Saudi states
checkpoints.note: The Al Saud of Diriyah founded the first Saudi state in alliance with Ibn Abd al-Wahhab. It was crushed in 1818, and Ibn Saud built a new one after taking Riyadh in 1902.

checkpoints.name: The kingdom
checkpoints.note: Ibn Saud proclaimed the kingdom in 1932 and oil was found in 1938. Oil wealth transformed the country, and the crown prince's Vision 2030 seeks a future beyond oil.
